name: The Mahjmont Society
description: Official site (Boston, MA): "Inspired by the beauty of coastal living and the art of thoughtful hosting, we set out to reimagine American Mahjong with modern design and elevated detail." Offers Mahjong 101 classes and drop-in open play; no membership requirement stated. Sessions held at Oakley Country Club (Belmont/Watertown area) and Cape Cod venues.
